description: Amateur satellites with periodic SSTV transmissions. Based on the 'Satellites with periodic SSTV' list by LU3FCI (Juan Carlos); NORAD IDs checked against CelesTrak and SatNOGS DB on 2026-10-18.
sstv_mode_note: sstv_mode is the mode SatNOGS DB lists for the downlink; blank means not published. Decoders that auto-detect the VIS code pick the mode for you.
